svg.title: Blueprint sheet 15, the tide: a rising tide lifts the boats, and hides the rocks

g.text: lifts the boats, and hides the rocks
but it is easier to live with.
everyone can get more at once.
more for one is less for another.
the choices come into the open.
the old saying: a rising tide
lifts all boats. true. it also
a living blueprint for a world
